title: Grid connection falls 184 days after the PPA target COD
why: The plant cannot export, and so cannot earn under the PPA, before it is connected. The connection lands 91 days before the PPA long-stop date, after which the buyer may terminate.
how: Both dates are quoted directly from the documents. Grid connection on 1 Oct 2029 comes 184 days after the target date for commercial operation, 31 Mar 2029.

citation.quote: The Connection Date shall be 1 October 2029

evidence.heading: 4. Connection
evidence.paragraph_text: The Maximum Export Capacity at the Point of Connection shall be 45 MW. The Connection Date shall be 1 October 2029, subject to completion of Reinforcement Works at Wickham Primary Substation.

citation.quote: Commercial Operation on or before 31 March 2029

evidence.heading: 6. Commercial Operation
evidence.paragraph_text: The Generator shall use reasonable endeavours to achieve Commercial Operation on or before 31 March 2029 (the "Target COD").
